vars.team_intro: For significant features or changes that are more than a few lines of code, use [Claude Code agent teams](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-teams) with a structured multi-agent approach.
vars.guard_hooks: A `PreToolUse` hook blocks the engineer's edits to sealed files and holdout reads where the agent is identifiable, and a `TaskCompleted` hook blocks completing any task while a sealed test is modified.
vars.worktree_section: **All teammates must work in the same worktree directory.** Before creating the team, set up a single worktree for the feature branch (use `/enter-worktree` or `git worktree add`). Then create the agent team from within that worktree so all teammates inherit it as their working directory.
vars.phase_intro:
### Phased execution with task dependencies

Use task dependencies to enforce phase ordering. Teammates within a phase can work in parallel; cross-phase work is blocked until dependencies complete.
